checks: PDF70 distinguishes 524.2 and 523.8 keV by coincidence and peak analysis. PDF77 gives an AB crossing near 0.26 MeV and a separate signature phase crossing near I=33/2.

PDF86–87 uses measured ADO and gate-dependent low-energy multiplet evidence. It explicitly leaves the E2 mixing component unresolved by this ADO analysis. PDF104 identifies the related 2010 journal report.
PDF97 distinguishes calculated effective proton thresholds at approximately 600 and 700 keV for different entrance configurations.
works.gap: Observed signature and angular ratios constrain placements; microscopic assignments remain interpretation-dependent. Numerical polarization and E2/M1 extraction for 128I were not reported in this analysis.
works.lineage: Distinct 173W and 128I in-beam experiments and telescope tests. The 128I journal report and thesis chapter share their data lineage.
